ledger.note: 813: Ermenguer founds the county of Empúries. 'Around 813, Empúries, with Peralada, became a separate county under Ermenguer'; infobox 'Establishment: 812' (the Sant Martí page: 'Charlemagne mentions Ermenguer as first Count of Empúries in 812'). 'After the Franks conquered the regions in 785, Empúries and Peralada came under the authority of the County of Girona.' The infobox 'Preceded by: Emirate of Córdoba'. The page gives no boundary; the region is Cliopatria's 1003 outline.

817: Empúries is joined to Roussillon. 'In 817, Empúries was merged with the County of Roussillon, a union which lasted until 989.' The Roussillon page: 'The first count known by name, Gaucelm, received the County of Empúries in 817.' Cliopatria draws the union as its County of Rosellón (896-999).

989: Empúries and Roussillon part. 'At the death of Gausfred I in 989, Roussillon and Empúries were separated.' Roussillon went to Gausfred's younger son Giselbert I. Cliopatria's Rosellón row keeps the land to 999.

The page does not say what ground Hugh held; no ground is named, so the zone is the frontier band (two cells either side) between the two Cliopatria shapes of 1014, not the whole county (changed in the fix pass of 2026-10-25 on the reviewer's non-blocking finding).

1079: the seat moves from Sant Martí to Castelló d'Empúries. 'In 1079, Castelló d'Empúries became the capital of the Empúries county due to the previous capital, Sant Martí d'Empúries, being too easily sacked by pirates.' The Sant Martí page: 'It was the county seat until 1079'. The Roussillon page says Gausfred I (931-989) 'made his capital at Castelló d'Empúries'; the two town pages and the date 1079 are followed.

1322: the comital house ends. 'Hugh's comital dynasty lasted until 1322, when Empúries passed to a collateral branch of his family.' Same state, same colour (rule 2); the list shows Marquesa 1322-1327 beside Hugh VI 1322-1325.
1325: the county is sold into the royal house. 'The last count, Hugh VI, sold the county to Peter IV of Ribagorza in 1325 in exchange for the barony of Pego'.

1341: Empúries becomes an apanage of the Crown. 'Peter later traded it with his brother Ramon Berenguer for the county of Prades in 1341.' 'From that point on, Empúries was an apanage of the Crown of Aragon.' No vassal tint is entered: the page does not make the county a vassal earlier or later.

1402: the counts are now the royal house itself. Infobox 'Annexed into the Principality of Catalonia: 1402'; the rulers table has Peter III (1401-1402), Joana I (1402), Maria de Luna (1402-1407) and Martin (1402 and 1407-1410). The county is kept as a distinct land until 1410 (see the dissolve).

1410: the county reverts to the Crown. 'Empúries escheated to the crown between 1410 and 1436.' The year is the earliest bound of that interval and the end of Martin's tenure in the list; Cliopatria draws the county to 1414.

1410: the County of Empúries ends as a state (infobox 'Succeeded by: Principality of Catalonia'). The page's list of counts resumes with Henry I in 1436, and the title is 'mostly honorific' afterwards.

notes: County of Empúries 813-1410 (Cliopatria 'County of Ampuria' 1000-1414, with a gap 1395-1401). Page budget 9; eight pages opened, one more (the Catalan Wikipedia article) failed. UNSETTLED: (1) Start: infobox 812, text c. 813; 813 kept. (2) 817-988 the county was united with Roussillon (the page says 'merged'); Cliopatria's County of Rosellón (896-999) contains the whole Empúries outline, so the dossier models the union as a merge (817) and split (989) and draws nothing of its own between; the county-of-rosellon dossier should cut the land from 989 (Cliopatria cuts it only from 1000). (3) End: infobox 'Annexed into the Principality of Catalonia: 1402' against the text 'escheated to the crown between 1410 and 1436' and counts listed to 1410; 1410 is kept, with a 1402 rename; Cliopatria's 1414 is four years late. (4) Vassalage: no page opened makes Empúries a vassal of Barcelona or Aragon (the Barcelona page says 'The counts, through marriage, alliances and treaties, acquired or vassalized the other Catalan counties' without dates, and, of Ramon Berenguer III, 'He conquered part of the County of Empúries', undated), so no vassal tint is entered; the 1341 apanage is recorded as a rename. (5) Capital: 1079 on the town pages against Gausfred I (late tenth century) on the Roussillon page. (6) The small shape changes (1028, 1040, 1126, 1169, 1177, 1188, 1236, 1279, 1344) are not explained by any page and carry no events. (7) The Catalan Wikipedia article 'Comtat d'Empúries' failed to load, which would have given the territorial history. (8) The page's ruler list has overlapping entries (Marquesa 1322-1327 beside Hugh VI; associated counts Dela, Bencion and Ponç Hug II), left out. Counterparts needing a dossier or a note: County of Girona (the 785 predecessor; probably Cliopatria's County of Barcelona), (County of Peralada (Pedralbes) was struck from this list in the fix pass: the page has Peralada inside Empúries from 813.) FIX PASS 2026-10-25 (author, after the reviewer's FAIL): (a) Keyframe county-of-ampuria_1000 is now 'adjust' with the 1003 outline (Empúries with Peralada), and the 1003 gain from 'County of Peralada (Pedralbes)' is deleted: the page ('Around 813, Empúries, with Peralada, became a separate county under Ermenguer') has Peralada inside the county from 813, and the December 1002 letter's 'county of Pedralbes' 'is probably to be identified with the Peralada region in the north of Empúries'. The Cliopatria drop to two cells in 1000-1002 is treated as Cliopatria's error. (b) The 1014-1019 contest zone and the war zone are now a border band of width 2 between county-of-ampuria and county-of-rosellon (8 cells in the gazetteer); confidence stays 2. (c) The ruler gap 850-852 is the page's own: its list ends William in 850 and starts Odalric in 852 and says nothing between; noted on Odalric. (d) Thin item: the Ramon Berenguer III page does not mention Empúries (it says he took almost all the Catalan counties 'except Urgell and Peralada'), so the 'conquered part of the County of Empúries' sentence of the County of Barcelona page stays undated and unplaced.
